Job Description:
About the job
8x8 connects our customers and teams globally, empowering CX leaders with performance and insights to make smarter decisions, delight customers, and drive lasting business impact.

8x8 is seeking a Product Manager to own two of the most consequential domains in our Finance Technology organization: ERP, Billing & Core Finance Platforms and Revenue & Monetization Platforms. This is not a traditional enterprise IT PM role. You will be the product conscience of systems that directly govern how 8x8 prices, bills, recognizes revenue, and closes its books.

You will sit at the intersection of Finance, Engineering, and go-to-market — translating complex monetization requirements into system architecture decisions, driving billing accuracy, and enabling the organization to move faster on pricing changes without sacrificing revenue integrity. You will work closely with the Director of Finance Technology and partner daily with functional leads across ERP, billing, RevRec, and integrations.

What You'll Own

ERP, Billing & Core Finance

Own the product roadmap for 8x8's billing engine (Logisense), order-to-cash workflows, and ERP systems (Netsuite GL/AP/AR)

Drive billing accuracy initiatives — reduce invoice defect rate, credit memo volume, and billing reruns through structured product improvements

Partner with the Billing/O2C functional specialist and ERP functional analyst to translate Finance requirements into prioritized engineering backlog

Define and track KPIs: invoice defect rate, ERP uptime, days-to-close trend, % automated journal entries, cash application automation

Revenue & Monetization Platforms

Own the product roadmap for pricing architecture, subscription lifecycle logic, and RevRec systems

Drive monetization agility — reduce time to launch new pricing models and enable pricing changes without external consultants

Ensure revenue integrity across the billing-to-RevRec pipeline, targeting zero restatement incidents and minimizing billing-to-RevRec variance

Support tax automation extension and evaluate pricing system requirements for potential M&A integration scenarios

Define and track KPIs: time to launch new pricing models, RevRec restatement incidents, billing-to-RevRec variance rate, post-release defect rate

What We're Looking For

Required Experience

6+ years in product management, with at least 3 years owning enterprise finance systems — ERP, billing engines, or revenue recognition platforms in a SaaS company

Hands-on experience with Netsuite (GL/AP/AR) or equivalent ERP, and a billing engine (Logisense, Zuora, or similar) — able to speak to configuration tradeoffs, not just outcomes

Fluency in order-to-cash and lead-to-cash flows — you can diagram the journey from a quote in Salesforce to a posted journal entry in the ERP without prompting

Working knowledge of ASC 606 and how RevRec system configuration drives compliance — you understand allocation logic, performance obligations, and restatement risk

Track record of driving billing accuracy and close efficiency improvements through system change, not just process workarounds

Experience partnering directly with Finance, Accounting, and Revenue Operations stakeholders — you speak their language and can translate business constraints into engineering requirements

Strongly Preferred

Experience with SFDC CPQ or equivalent quoting/pricing configuration

Familiarity with tax integration systems (Avalara, Vertex) and how configuration changes propagate through billing and ERP

Experience working in a hybrid matrix org model with matrixed engineering resources

Key Competencies

Systems Thinking

Revenue Integrity

Stakeholder Management

Monetization Architecture

Backlog Discipline

ERP Configuration Literacy

M&A Readiness

Data-Driven Prioritization

Cross-functional Influence

The Team You'll Work With

You'll join Finance Technology organization — a lean, high-accountability team of functional domain leads, billing and ERP specialists, and matrixed engineering across application, integration, data, and AI disciplines. The team is mid-transformation: several major platform migrations are underway (Logisense, CPAAS billing, Paymentus/Gaviti interface), and the roadmap over the next 12 months is ambitious.

This role is a critical hire. You will bring product rigor to a domain that has historically been led by strong functional operators — and you will raise the bar on roadmap predictability, delivery accountability, and executive stakeholder communication.

Why This Role

Greenfield opportunity to introduce modern product management practice into a finance systems org that is ready for it

Active, high-stakes roadmap — you won't be maintaining a stable system; you'll be building and migrating critical infrastructure

Collaborative org model with clear domain accountability and strong engineering partners

Competitive Compensation, Equity, And Benefits

The compensation range reflects the Company’s good faith belief at the time of posting. 8x8 has different base pay ranges for different work locations within the United States, which allows us to pay employees competitively and consistently in different geographic markets. The range above reflects the potential base pay across the U.S. for this role; the applicable base pay range will depend on what ultimately is determined to be the candidate’s primary work location. About the job
Kroll's Real Estate Advisory Group (REAG) is building a benchmarking capability that aggregates Kroll's proprietary valuation data alongside industry-standard indices to deliver comparative analytics across commercial real estate portfolios. The capability will ship as a new module within the existing KREV (Kroll Real Estate Valuation Solutions) platform, with both a dedicated benchmarking experience and an inline overlay on existing portfolio views.

We are hiring a Product Manager to own this initiative end-to-end — from scope and methodology through phased delivery and client launch. REAG currently touches roughly 10,000 assets annually, representing $20–30 billion in gross asset value per quarter, but does not systematically harness that data for benchmarking. Closing that gap is a strategic priority for the group.

This role sits at the intersection of product, data, and real estate valuation. You will work directly with REAG leadership, valuation practitioners, an India-based engineering team, and external stakeholders to deliver a production-grade benchmark that clients trust and practitioners use.

Day-to-Day Responsibilities

 Own the product roadmap  for the REAG Benchmarking Platform across the three-phase delivery plan (Foundation → KREV Integration & Internal Launch → GA & Expansion), spanning roughly 10 months from kickoff.
 Translate benchmarking methodology into product requirements — metric definitions, segmentation logic, anonymization rules, and publication cadence — working with REAG subject-matter experts on validation.
 Coordinate across functions:  REAG practitioners, the India-based engineering team (backend, UI, data), Legal, and Business Development.
 Manage data source integration  across REAG's proprietary valuation systems and third-party index data, including normalization, deduplication, and historical coverage.
 Define the KREV integration experience — both the dedicated Benchmarking module and the inline portfolio overlay on existing views.
 Run the quarterly production cycle — data freeze dates, QA gates, publication calendar, and on-time delivery commitments to clients.
 Drive pilot and GA launch  with selected GP clients, incorporate feedback, and expand to the full KREV client base.
 Track and report progress  against coverage, adoption, and reliability targets.
 Manage risk  across data quality, licensing, segment depth, and SME availability, with documented mitigations.

Essential Traits

 5+ years of product management experience, with at least 2 years on data products, analytics platforms, or benchmarking tools.
 Working knowledge of commercial real estate valuation — cap rates, discount rates, NOI, DCF methodology, and how appraisers use comparable data. You do not need to be a former appraiser, but you must be credible in conversations with REAG practitioners and GP clients.
 Familiarity with the institutional real estate fund manager (GP/LP) ecosystem.
 Experience shipping products that depend on structured data ingestion, normalization, and deduplication across multiple source systems.
 Demonstrated ability to manage distributed engineering teams (this role coordinates a four-person India-based team) and to operate across time zones.
 Strong written communication — you can produce PRDs, methodology documentation, and client-facing materials that hold up under scrutiny from legal, compliance, and sophisticated GP clients.
 Comfort operating in regulated and confidential data environments, including engagement-letter data use restrictions and anonymization requirements.

Preferred Qualifications

 Prior work on a benchmarking, index, or peer-comparison product.
 Experience integrating third-party data subscriptions with attention to licensing and redistribution terms.
 Background in financial services, asset management, or a Big Four / valuation advisory firm.
 Familiarity with quarterly production cycles and the operational discipline they require.
 Knowledge of commercial real estate markets, asset classes, and industry dynamics is a plus.

About the job

Our apps, Raya and Places, are tools for discovery of and access to exciting people and places globally. We believe that by marrying great software with a membership-based community built around core values of trust, curation, and authenticity, we can provide solutions that have heretofore been impossible. Places’ mission is to help discerning global travelers find their favorite places wherever they go through expert curation and community trust.

As a Product Manager on Places, you turn product direction into shipped software. You will own priorities and goals set by leadership and be responsible for their delivery: writing the specs, leading the cross-functional team day to day, and driving the work from idea to launch.

This is an execution-first role. Your job is to make the team productive and the outcomes real: clarify requirements, coordinate engineering, design, and QA, keep the work on track, and stay in the details until it ships. Strong ideas are welcome and the best ones get built. As you build judgment and earn trust, you'll grow into more of the "what and why."

Places’ team is composed of talented, compassionate individuals from all over the globe with diverse backgrounds and professional experiences including folks from Apple, Google, Amazon, Meta, Snap, Twitter, Instacart, Paypal and more. We prioritize learning and teamwork and love giving people the opportunity to champion big challenges and grow into better versions of themselves.

Key Responsibilities

Turn direction into shipped work: Take goals and priorities from product leadership and translate them into clear, buildable specs with defined requirements and success criteria
Drive cross-functional delivery: Lead engineering, design, QA, and other stakeholders day to day from problem to launch. Run the standups, track the work, unblock the team, and keep things moving
Own the details: Manage scope, timelines, and dependencies. Surface risks early and keep leadership informed on progress and trade-offs
Partner with QA on quality: Work with QA and engineering to test thoroughly and hold the team to the quality bar before we ship
Bring ideas and evidence: Pressure-test concepts with users, prototypes, and data, and bring well-formed proposals to product leadership. The strongest ideas earn their way onto the roadmap
Measure what shipped: Help define and instrument the metrics for your work, then report honestly on whether it moved them
Communicate clearly: Keep partner teams and leadership aligned on status, blockers, and results. Escalate the right things at the right time


Qualifications

Bachelor's degree, or equivalent practical experience. 
At least 2 years of experience in product management, or an adjacent role (engineering, design, product operations, program management) with a path into product. 
Strong organizational and project management skills. You keep complex, multi-person work on track. 
Genuine user empathy and developing product sense. You care whether what we ship is actually good. 
Comfortable with data: you can read a metric, ask the right questions, and tell when something isn't working. 
Excellent communication. You write clearly and keep cross-functional teams aligned. 
Familiarity with agile delivery and modern product tooling. 
Low-ego, high-ownership, eager to learn from senior PMs and leadership. 


What Set's You Apart

Reliable Executor: You ship. Work handed to you gets done well, on time, without dropping details. 
Idea-Generative: You spot opportunities and make a sharp case for them, knowing the bar is evidence and impact, not seniority. 
Empathetic Collaborator: You earn trust across engineering, design, and QA and make the team around you more effective. 
Growth-Oriented: A perpetual learner, open to feedback, hungry to grow into broader product ownership over time. 
Impact-Driven: You drive toward the goal, problem-solve blockers, and make the right trade-offs to meet your commitments.
